claims.value: SILAC light = unstimulated (serum-starved, no G-CSF) cells of the same receptor line
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol and paper Methods: "Cells grown in heavy SILAC medium were stimulated with G-CSF (40 ng/mL) for 12.5 mins and 90 mins ... and cells grown in light medium were left unstimulated". Data check (orientation.txt): canonical G-CSF-induced sites are H>L: ERK1/2 TEY 4/4 positive (log2 H/L 8.2-10.5 at 12.5 min), RSK S380 motif 37/44 positive, STAT3 S727 14/17 positive.

claims.value: SILAC heavy = G-CSF stimulated (12.5 min or 90 min)
claims.evidence: Same statement and data check as the light claim; Quantdatacombined.xls values are log2(heavy/light) = stimulated vs non-stimulated (paper Data Records, perl normalisation section).

claims.location: characteristics[cell line], characteristics[cellosaurus accession], characteristics[cellosaurus name] rows 1-292
claims.evidence: Paper: "BaF3 cell lines stably expressing normal and mutated G-CSFRs", Sample Characteristic BA/F3 cell. Cellosaurus CVCL_0161 (synonyms BaF3) DR EFO_0022749 = EFO label "BA/F3". The transduced derivatives are lab-made and have no own Cellosaurus entry.

Cellosaurus CVCL_0161: "Derived from site: In situ; Bone marrow; UBERON=UBERON_0002371"; "Cell type: Pro-B cell; CL=CL_0000826". PRIDE organismParts lists "B cell" and "cell suspension culture"; pro-B cell is the more specific CL term.

Cellosaurus: "Breed/subspecies: C3H"; "Caution: Originally thought to originate from a BALB/c mouse but is in fact from a C3H mouse (PubMed=25277546)". Free-text column; validate-sdrf warning about NCBITaxon is expected.

Ba/F3 is an IL-3-dependent, non-tumorigenic pro-B line; Cellosaurus lists no disease. The receptor mutations model CNL/AML but the cells are not leukaemic; PRIDE "acute leukemia" (DOID:12603) is the study context, not a property of the samples. PATO:0000461.
Cultured BaF3 cells.
pY1000 immunoaffinity flow-through, high-pH RP fractions each enriched with TiO2 spin tips for pS/pT peptides. EFO:0010806.
Paper/PRIDE: "RPMI medium (Invitrogen)" with 5% FBS, SILAC RPMI with light or heavy Lys/Arg. NCIT:C178973. "1640" is inferred (RPMI 1640 is the RPMI formulation used for SILAC); see limitations.

Paper and PRIDE data protocol: "TripleTOF 5600+ MS (Sciex)". The .wiff device string reads "TripleTOF 5600" and PRIDE instruments field says MS:1000932, but a reference .wiff from a TripleTOF 5600+ (PXD001997) carries the same "TripleTOF 5600" device string, so the raw header does not distinguish the models; the explicit Methods statement is kept. reconcile agrees.

limitations: SILAC label conflict resolved against the wet-lab text: PRIDE protocol and paper Methods say heavy medium contained "arginine-13C6 ... lysine-13C6" (Arg6/Lys6), while the paper and all 12 .group files use ProteinPilot "SILAC (Lys+8, Arg+10)" and the companion pY deposit PXD009662 says "C-13, N-15 Lysine and Arginine". The decoded WT90minRep2 search identified 16,926 confident (>=0.95) matches carrying K[+08]/R[+10] vs 18,860 unlabelled K/R matches; a +6 label would not give confident +8/+10 identifications at that rate. Annotated as Lys8/Arg10 (UNIMOD:259/267). Only one group file was decoded in full; the other 11 were checked for identical UI settings only.

9 runs excluded because their .wiff sample name is "Blank" (no sample): Q741x12.5minRep1 Data030216_17, Q741x90minRep1 Data030516_13, Q741x90minRep2 Data030616_13, T618I12.5minRep2 Data081916_24, T618I90minRep1 Data082016_24, WT12.5minRep1 Data111715_13, WT12.5minRep2 Data111815_13, WT90minRep1 Data111915_13, WT90minRep2 Data112015_13. The WT90minRep2 combined search did include Data112015_13 (blank).
WT 90 min Rep 2 has 11 fraction runs: fraction 9 (Data112015_09) is not in the deposit; its combined search used the 11 fractions plus the blank.

Data081416_04 and Data081416_15 (T618I 12.5 min Rep 1 Frac 2 and Frac 7) contain no spectra (.wiff.scan 44 bytes); they are annotated (technical replicate 1) because they are deposited runs of the mixture; their re-injections Frac 2b/7b are technical replicate 2. Whether the failed runs were in the combined search was not checked (group file not decoded in full).

Light-culture independence per mixture is inferred from the paper (12 independent pairwise mixtures, light and heavy mixed per pairwise comparison); the paper does not say explicitly that each mixture used a separately grown light culture.
Receptor cDNA species (human vs mouse CSF3R) is not stated; the genotype values name the variants only. G-CSF source/species not stated.
Culture medium: the source says "RPMI medium"; RPMI 1640 is inferred.
characteristics[sex], [developmental stage], [passage number] not available: Cellosaurus CVCL_0161 has no sex or age; passage not reported.

ProteinPilot Paragon is a probabilistic search over many biological modifications; comment[modification parameters] lists the label, alkylation and emphasis mods set in the UI plus the two most frequent biological mods, not the full Paragon mod list.
The .wiff device string "TripleTOF 5600" vs Methods "TripleTOF 5600+": resolved to 5600+ (see instrument claim).
